name: Vivacious Gnome
text: You have an incredibly strong connection to the vitality energy that flows through the First World, making it harder to attack your life force with void energy. You gain void resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). When you have the Doomed condition, the condition affects you as if its value was 1 lower than it actually is (doomed 1 has no effect, doomed 2 causes you to die at Dying 3, and so on).
